apps.localizedDescription: VexSign is a powerful on-device iOS app signer and installer. Sign and install apps with a .p12 / .mobileprovision pair, manage tweaks (.dylib/.deb/.framework/.bundle/.appex), transfer files over HTTP/WebDAV, and track app updates — entirely on-device.
